summary.text:
Global equity markets declined amid pressure on tech, with the Nasdaq 100 dropping 2.67% and the S&P 500 falling 1.92%. Nvidia lost 4.12% after dismissing a campaign to reinstate its former chief executive. Broad risk aversion drove volatility sharply higher, lifting the VIX by 18.7% to 22.91.

In foreign exchange and commodities, the dollar index held unchanged at 103.529, while the euro slipped 0.15% to 1.1008 and the yen advanced, pushing USDJPY down 0.26% to 159.362. Gold was flat at 3877.8999. Brent crude and WTI crude were also unchanged at 91.74 and 85.1 respectively, while Bitcoin fell 0.9% to 64719.3516.

Looking ahead, investors are assessing how the Federal Reserve chairman interprets the economic impact of the AI revolution. Markets are also following potential Indian tax reforms regarding foreign investors and union mobilization scheduled for November 17 in France.
